attributes.board_name: North Dakota Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of local/state/regional/national veterinary associations, board-approved seminars, AAVSB RACE programs, college wet labs, objective commercial presentations (approval), USDA accreditation modules (half credit); max 8 h practice management, 8 h exchange program, 4 h board meeting attendance
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed fewer than 24 months before the even-year renewal: requirement adjusted proportionally.
rules.audit_note: Proof of attendance on request; verification may be through a third-party database.
rules.notes: License renewed annually by June 30 ($110); CE (24 h in prior 24 months) certified at even-year renewals. At least 18 h in person or live virtual, so max 6 h prerecorded.
